## Identity

- Full name: Jawad Boulmal
- Arabic name: جواد بولمال
- Also known as / handles: JB, Skayologie (GitHub/Stack Overflow handle)
- Name is also seen spelled/transliterated as: Jaouad Boulmal (standard
  French transliteration of the same Arabic name), Jawed Boulmal / Jawwad
  Boulmal (genuine alternate transliterations, not typos), Jawad Boulmali,
  Jawad Boulmale, Jawad Boumal. It is also sometimes typed with a dropped
  interior consonant, e.g. "Jaad Boulal" for "Jawad Boulmal". In Arabic
  script: جواد بولمال, and since "Boulmal" is a Darija-origin surname
  without one fixed Arabic spelling, also جواد بو لمال، جواد بلمال، جواد
  بومال، جواد بولمالي. All of these refer to the same person.
- Role: Full Stack Developer
- Location: Casablanca, Morocco
- Website: https://jawadboulmal.com
- Email: jawadboulmal@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Skayologie
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jawadboulmal/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/~jawadboulmal
- Stack Overflow: https://stackoverflow.com/users/26262428/skay-37

## Summary

Jawad Boulmal is a Full Stack Developer based in Casablanca, Morocco, who
builds scalable backend architectures and robust web applications. He is
currently a Full Stack Developer at DabaDoc, working across Ruby on Rails,
Angular, and React on digital health features — from online appointment
booking to complex medical practice management. He is also completing
advanced Full Stack Java/Angular/Spring training at YouCode - UM6P
(Mohammed VI Polytechnic University).

## Current Work

**DabaDoc** — Full Stack Developer (Ruby on Rails, Angular, React) —
Casablanca, Morocco — February 2026–present.
Works across the DabaDoc digital health platform: building backend features
in Ruby, paired with responsive Angular/React interfaces, covering the full
flow from online appointment booking to medical practice management tools.

## Projects

**envault** (2026) — Zero-cloud, git-native .env encryption for teams. Share
secrets securely through an existing Git repository using hybrid
AES-256-GCM + RSA-4096 encryption, with no third-party services and no
monthly fees. Published on npm as @jawadboulmal/envault.
Source: https://github.com/Skayologie/envault
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jawadboulmal/envault

**WorkPilot** (2026) — A personal work environment manager for Windows. One
command starts everything needed for the day (Docker, VS Code, Chrome tabs,
project services); one command stops it all. Includes a Telegram bot for
remote control.
Source: https://github.com/Skayologie/WorkPilot

**SHDownloader** (2026) — A lightweight, terminal-based YouTube video/audio
downloader in Python. One-command install on Windows and macOS/Linux, smart
playlist detection, auto-organization, and self-updating via yt-dlp.
Source: https://github.com/Skayologie/SHDownloader

**L'7sab App** — A collaborative group-expense management and sharing app.
Supports group creation, real-time transaction tracking, and automatic
balance calculation to simplify repayments between participants. Built with
Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Next.js, Tailwind CSS.
Site: https://www.l7sab.me

**SmartShop** — A B2B commercial management REST backend: client, product,
and multi-product order management with automatic loyalty and progressive
discounts, split payments, automatic VAT/total calculation, layered
architecture, and JUnit/Mockito test coverage. Built with Spring Boot,
JPA/Hibernate, PostgreSQL, MapStruct, Lombok.

**Qarib App** (2025) — A Flutter app connecting users with local service
providers for booking and real-time order tracking, with geolocation and
status updates. Built with Flutter, Nest.js, MySQL, Firebase, hosted on
Digital Ocean.

**DevHub** (2025) — A Reddit-inspired platform for developers to share ideas,
with authentication, posts, comments, and voting. Built with Laravel, PHP,
Blade, MySQL, responsive Tailwind UI.
Source: https://github.com/Skayologie/CodeSpace/tree/develop

**Event Management Platform** (2025) — An Eventbrite-inspired platform for
creating, discovering, and managing events, built with pure PHP and AJAX.
Source: https://github.com/Skayologie/Eventbrite
